record.paper_title: Current work and open problems in the numerical analysis of Volterra functional equations with vanishing delays
record.original_question: For the weakly singular Volterra functional integral equation u(t) = b(t)u(θ(t)) + g(t) + (V_αu)(t) + (V_{θ,α}u)(t), analyze whether the analogue of Theorem 2.2 continues to hold on graded meshes of the form t_n = (n/N)^r T with r \ge m/(1-α).

evidence.quote: Open Problem 3.2 In analogy to Open Problem 2.1, analyse the extension of Theorem 2.2 to the weakly singular VFIE (3.4) with b(t) \equiv 0, for graded meshes of the form (3.7).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the weakly singular Volterra functional integral equation with vanishing (proportional) delay

  u(t) = b(t) u(θ(t)) + g(t) + (V_α u)(t) + (V_{θ,α} u)(t),   t ∈ I := [0, T],

where:
- θ : I → I is a smooth vanishing delay with θ(0)=0, 0 < θ(t) < t for t ∈ (0,T], and 0 < θ'(t) ≤ q < 1 (the canonical case being the pantograph delay θ(t)=qt);
- b, g : I → ℝ are given smooth functions, with b(t) ≡ 0 in the case considered here;
- the weakly singular Volterra operators are
    (V_α u)(t) = ∫_0^t (t−s)^{−α} K_1(t,s) u(s) ds,
    (V_{θ,α} u)(t) = ∫_0^{θ(t)} (t−s)^{−α} K_2(t,s) u(s) ds,
  with 0 < α < 1 and smooth kernels K_1, K_2.

For an integer N ≥ 1, define the graded mesh on I by

  t_n = (n/N)^r T,   n = 0, 1, …, N,    with grading exponent r ≥ m/(1−α),

where m ≥ 1 is the degree of the piecewise polynomial collocation space S_m^{(-1)}(I_N) used to compute the approximate solution u_N of the equation by collocation at m prescribed points in each subinterval [t_{n−1}, t_n].

The known result (the analogue of which is denoted "Theorem 2.2") establishes, for the corresponding equation without a vanishing-delay weakly singular term (V_{θ,α} u), optimal global convergence orders and local superconvergence at the mesh points for collocation solutions on such graded meshes.

Problem. Determine whether the analogous statement remains valid for the full equation above (with the additional vanishing-delay weakly singular operator V_{θ,α}). Specifically, establish (or disprove) optimal-order global convergence on I and identify the attainable order of local superconvergence of the collocation solution u_N at the mesh points {t_n} when t_n = (n/N)^r T with r ≥ m/(1−α).
artifact.category_tag: Volterra integral equations with vanishing delays
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature on collocation methods for weakly singular Volterra integral equations with vanishing/proportional delays (e.g., convergence analyses on uniform and graded meshes for second-kind delay VIEs with weakly singular kernels, and analyses of first-kind versions) has addressed related cases, but no paper found provides a complete extension of the relevant superconvergence theorem to the full second-kind weakly singular VFIE with both V_α and V_{θ,α} terms on graded meshes with r ≥ m/(1−α). The problem appears to remain open in this general form, with partial progress in adjacent settings.

status_evidence.title: Convergence analysis of collocation solutions for delay Volterra integral equations with weakly singular kernels
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence of the collocation solution for second kind VIEs with weakly singular kernels and vanishing (proportional) delays is proved under certain conditions on the collocation parameters, on uniform and graded meshes.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on related delay weakly singular VIEs on graded meshes, but does not fully resolve the stated extension.

status_evidence.title: Theoretical and numerical analysis of a first-kind linear Volterra functional integral equation with weakly singular kernel and vanishing delay
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses a first-kind weakly singular VFIE with proportional delay posed as an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Some adjacent open problems in this program have been addressed, but the second-kind extension with V_{θ,α} on graded meshes is not established here.

status_evidence.title: Current work and open problems in the numerical analysis of Volterra functional equations with vanishing delays
status_evidence.snippet: Survey identifying open problems including the extension of superconvergence results to weakly singular VFIEs with vanishing-delay terms on graded meshes.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is identified as open in the source survey.
